about: Top 200 everyday ASL signs for phone calls. Chosen from ASL-LEX 2.0 subjective frequency (deaf raters), 6 published core-vocabulary lists, and phone-call vocabulary research; each measured on 8 ASL Citizen signers' clips with SignBart-ASL-2730 (model via Fingertip by Shruti). Clips may overlap the model's training data, so these are upper bounds, not accuracy on new signers. Built by eval_signs/.
